figure: Figure 8.1 (Where inference computation and data movement actually live)
issue: In the green 'GPU interconnect' box, the subtitle line 'GPU↔GPU and host link' is left-flushed: its leftmost glyph sits at (and appears to touch/clip) the box's left border, with no horizontal margin. Every other box's subtitle is centered with clear side margins (e.g. 'on-die', 'large · slower', 'farthest', 'on-chip · close').
evidence: Rendered 150 dpi page: the 'GPU interconnect' box's third line starts exactly on the left border line, whereas the 'other GPUs / remote' box directly below shows a visible left margin on each of its lines. The line is the longest subtitle in the ladder and overflows the centered layout.
acceptance_test: Re-render at print size and confirm the subtitle has ≥ ~4–6 pt of horizontal clearance from the box border on both sides with no clipped glyph; if the line is too long, wrap it to two centered lines (matching the other boxes) instead of left-flushing it.

issue: Gratuitous visual-encoding inconsistency for the same three components of the same 640 GB 8×H100 pool across two adjacent Ch 7 figures. Weights are consistent (blue diagonal hatch) in both, but the KV component is a GREEN band with vertical slot lines in 7.7 yet an ORANGE dotted band in 7.8, and the runtime component is a SOLID dark-gray box in 7.7 yet a LIGHT-gray cross-hatched box in 7.8. A reader comparing the two decompositions must re-learn the color/pattern mapping.
evidence: Fig 7.7 (p125): segments = blue-hatch '140 GB weights', solid charcoal '~64 GB runtime', green-with-vertical-rules '~436 GB KV budget'. Fig 7.8 (p126) legend: orange-dotted 'KV cache (grows with context)', blue-hatch 'weights 140 GB', light-gray cross-hatch 'runtime / NCCL ~64 GB'. The KV and runtime encodings differ between the two figures with no stated reason.
acceptance_test: Harmonize the palette so weights/runtime/KV use the same color+pattern in both 7.7 and 7.8; if the green=reserved-KV-budget vs orange=KV-actually-used distinction is intentional, make the runtime encoding identical in both and state the budget-vs-used color difference explicitly in both captions/legends.
